title: Cartan matrix of a finite root system
description: The convention is the whole content here. B_n and C_n have transposed Cartan matrices and are non-isomorphic for n >= 3, so reading a matrix under the wrong convention does not fail — it silently names so(7) where sp(6) was meant.

entries.description: a_ij = 2 (alpha_i, alpha_j) / (alpha_j, alpha_j); square, a_ii = 2. policy: primary. convention: cartan-matrix-bourbaki.

cartan_type.description: e.g. A3, B3, D4, E8, or a product. policy: derived-cheap.
